# GitHub social preview

`social-preview.png` (1280×640) is the card GitHub shows when a link to
this repository is shared: Slack, X, LinkedIn, a chat window.

GitHub stores this image outside the repository, so committing it is not
enough. It has to be uploaded once, by somebody with admin rights:

**Settings → General → Social preview → Edit → Upload an image**

Until that upload happens the link unfurls with GitHub's generic
fallback — the repository name, the description and the owner's avatar.

The image is generated in the commercial tree, from a capture taken
against a Vigil Core build rather than the paid edition, which is why the
dashboard in it has five nav items and reads 10/11: that is what Core
actually ships.
